payment_vs_item_total_by_order: SELECT "order_id", sum(TRY_CAST("price" AS DOUBLE) + TRY_CAST("freight_value" AS DOUBLE)) AS item_total
SELECT "order_id", sum(TRY_CAST("payment_value" AS DOUBLE)) AS pay_total,
sum(CASE WHEN abs(pay_total - item_total) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_with_difference,
sum(CASE WHEN pay_total - item_total > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payment_greater,
sum(CASE WHEN item_total - pay_total > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payment_smaller,
sum(CASE WHEN abs(pay_total - item_total) > 0.01 AND max_installments > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differences_with_installments,
sum(CASE WHEN max_installments > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_with_installments
customer_id_vs_unique_id: SELECT count(*) AS customer_rows, count(DISTINCT "customer_id") AS distinct_customer_id,
orders_per_unique_customer: SELECT n AS orders_per_unique_customer, count(*) AS customers
FROM (SELECT "customer_unique_id", count(*) AS n FROM "customers" GROUP BY 1)
review_id_duplicates: SELECT count(*) AS duplicate_review_id_groups, coalesce(sum(n), 0) AS rows_in_groups, coalesce(max(n), 0) AS max_rows_per_review_id
FROM (SELECT "review_id", count(*) AS n FROM "order_reviews" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1)
orders_without_items: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM "orders" o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order_items" i WHERE i."order_id" = o."order_id")
orders_without_payments: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM "orders" o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order_payments" p WHERE p."order_id" = o."order_id")
orders_without_reviews: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM "orders" o
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "order_reviews" r WHERE r."order_id" = o."order_id")
delivery_date_missing_by_status: sum(CASE WHEN ("order_delivered_customer_date" IS NULL OR "order_delivered_customer_date" = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_delivered_customer_date,
sum(CASE WHEN ("order_approved_at" IS NULL OR "order_approved_at" = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_approved_at
delivered_before_purchase: WHERE TRY_CAST("order_delivered_customer_date" AS TIMESTAMP) < TRY_CAST("order_purchase_timestamp" AS TIMESTAMP)
item_price_and_freight_signs: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("price" AS DOUBLE) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS price_not_positive,
sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("freight_value" AS DOUBLE) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS freight_negative,
sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("freight_value" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS freight_zero
payment_value_by_type: sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("payment_value" AS DOUBLE) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_not_positive
